page.layout: Left page: one text column in the centre, with an empty column to its left. Running head above the column, page number at top left. Chapter mark "CAP. III." at the foot right. Right page: only its left edge is visible, cut off by the scan. Its running head and the start of its text column are partly visible.

main_text.p: fidimus,] Et alibi [Intelligit singularis & admirabilis sapientia tua Gloriosissi-me Auguste] Et alibi : [non solum verbis, sed etiam lachrymis deprecamur.] Et alibi, Pro incolumitate & beatitudine tua, offerant preces.] Et deniq;, nulla quidem suspitio erit non modo seditionis; sed nec asperæ murmurationis; tandem vero concludit; Dei omnipotentis clementia, te nobis custodiat clementissime ac Religiosissime Imperator.] Meminit quidem Becanus Libri à Lucifero Caralitano Episcopo de non parcendo in Deum delinquenti, & Baronius de Regibus Apostatis utriusque in hunc Imperatorem conscripti, verum hunc eundem Luciferum fuisse, à quo postea in hæresim lapso Luciferiani, contra quos scripsit Sanctus Hieronymus suum mutuati sunt nomen, apud omnes in confesso est.

page.notes: The right page is cut off at the scan edge. Only fragments of its first lines are visible, including an italic "De" at the top and a large initial "C". I could not read them, so they are marked illegible; the lines shown are only the first few of many. The right-hand running head is also cut off. The left column of the left page is empty. "CAP. III." is a chapter mark at the foot of the text and is not a heading. Long s is printed as "f" in some words (e.g. "fed", "fuspitio"); I have written these as s. The word "fidimus" is printed with a true f, so I kept it as written.
